portInfo.description: Sharm El Sheikh Port (UNCTAD EGSSH) sits on the southern Sinai Red Sea coast. Official pages publish coordinates 27°51.2′N / 34°17′E, passenger berths 1 (570 m) and 2 (116 m), and yacht gates. MedCruise’s Egyptian Ports facts cite differing maximum ship dimensions and quay totals — ships must follow the line’s declared draught/LOA limits. AD Ports Group stated in May 2026 that cruise terminal services commenced after Ministry of Transport / RSPA docking upgrades.

climate.description: Desert climate with hot summers and warm winters

politics.visaRequirements: Visa required for most nationalities. Visa on arrival available for many (30 days).
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity. Visa on arrival or e-visa available.
